# AM Growth Partners

> AM Growth Partners is an education admissions growth consulting and execution firm based in Madhapur, Hyderabad, India. We help schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and education brands turn fragmented admissions processes into structured, measurable enrolment growth systems.

## Services

- [Admissions Funnel Strategy](https://amgrowthp.com/#services): Funnel audits and leak mapping, lead qualification, follow-up workflows and SLAs, walk-in process optimisation, lost-lead reactivation, and conversion tracking.
- [Counsellor Enablement & SOPs](https://amgrowthp.com/#services): Telecaller and admissions counsellor training, first-call scripts, objection handling for parent hesitation, and daily performance KPIs.
- [Brand & Digital Growth](https://amgrowthp.com/#services): Conversion landing pages, local catchment search campaigns, and Google & Meta ads optimised for qualified parents.
- [Performance & Expansion](https://amgrowthp.com/#services): Leadership analytics dashboards and campus scalability planning.

## Who We Help

- K-12 schools (CBSE, ICSE, IB)
- Private colleges and universities
- Coaching institutes (IIT-JEE, NEET, Civil Services)
- EdTech and higher-education brands
